name: astrology-insights
description: Comprehensive Vedic astrology engine for Node.js — Panchang, birth charts (Kundli), Vimshottari Dasha, divisional charts, dosha analysis, and planetary remedies. Swiss Ephemeris precision, validated against Drik Panchang.

scripts.build: npx tsc --outDir dist --rootDir . --declaration --skipLibCheck --module commonjs --target ES2020 --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule $(find panchang/src -name '*.ts' ! -name '*.d.ts' ! -name '*.bak*')
scripts.check:dist: node -e "for (const m of ['./dist/panchang/src/birthchart/index','./dist/panchang/src/birthchart/divisional/shodashvarga','./dist/panchang/src/panchang-v2']) require(m); console.log('dist loads')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm test

author: Adarsh Srivastava
